sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def getp(ns):
    N=W=None
    for n in ns:
        bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
        if n['color']=='N': N=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']==4: W=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    if not N or not W: return None
    r0,r1,c0,c1=N; w0,w1,x0,x1=W
    if w0==r0-1: f='U'
    elif w1==r1+1: f='D'
    elif x0==c0-1: f='L'
    elif x1==c1+1: f='R'
    else: f='?'
    return (min(r0,w0),max(r1,w1),min(c0,x0),max(c1,x1),f)
seq=['UP']*4+['RIGHT']*10+['DOWN']*6
action(seq)
print("after nav:",getp(current_frame.segmentation['nodes']))
for n in sorted(current_frame.segmentation['nodes'],key=lambda x:x['id']):
    bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
    if n['color'] in 'bcgO':
        print(f"  {n['color']} rows{min(rs)}-{max(rs)} cols{min(cs)}-{max(cs)} px{n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
